 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5c206415",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Horizontal ramp with a step\n",
    "This notbook covers the conformal mapping of a horizontal ramp with a step. The step is centerd along th `y`-axis and of a defined hight ``h``.\n",
    "\n",
    "## The mapping\n",
    "The mapping is dervied using Schwartz-Christoffel and is of the from\n",
    "$$\n",
    "z = \\frac{h}{\\pi}\\left[ \\sqrt{\\chi - 1} \\sqrt{\\chi + 1}  + \\ln\\left(\\chi + \\sqrt{\\chi - 1} \\sqrt{\\chi + 1}\\right)\\right]\n",
    "$$"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "12341f25",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Imports\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f66ddc45",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We define the ramp with the following variable"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "af95e6f9",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Variables\n",
    "h = 1\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot limits\n",
    "xlim = (-10, 10)\n",
    "ylim = (-1, h + 1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "17fd2397",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The ramp is mapped on to the half-plane, or rather the half plane in the `chi`-plane is mapped onto the ramp in the `z`-plane.\n",
    "\n",
    "```{warning}\n",
    "Becuse the mapping is from `chi`to `z`the elements must be defined in the `chi`plane.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "c2a97427",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1500x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15, 5))\n",
    "ax[0].fill_between([xlim[0], 0, 0, xlim[1]], [h, h, 0, 0], y2=-1, facecolor=(.8,.8,.8,.5), edgecolor=\"k\")\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlim(xlim)\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylim(ylim)\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\"z-plane\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Chi-plane plot\n",
    "ax[1].fill_between([xlim[0],xlim[1]], [0, 0], y2=-1, facecolor=(.8,.8,.8,.5), edgecolor=\"k\")\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlim(xlim)\n",
    "ax[1].set_ylim(ylim)\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\"chi-plane\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "01235507",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Horizonatal uniform flow\n",
    "We model horizontal uniform flow by defining unfirom flow parallel to the `x`-axis in the `chi`-plane."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "29ddfc75",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Varialbes\n",
    "w = 1 + 0j\n",
    "\n",
    "# Omega function\n",
    "omega_func = lambda z: omega_uni_flow(z, w, map_chi_to_z(lambda chi: xi_to_ramp(chi, h)))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "096c9cfd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We can now plot the solution"
   ]
  }
